mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS peerId, u.username, u.avatarUrl, u.planetCode, m.content AS lastContent, m.createTime AS lastTime, t.unread FROM ( SELECT IF(fromUserId = #{me}, toUserId, fromUserId) AS peer, MAX(id) AS maxId, SUM(CASE WHEN toUserId = #{me} AND isRead = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread FROM chat_message WHERE fromUserId = #{me} OR toUserId = #{me} GROUP BY peer ) t JOIN chat_message m ON m.id = t.maxId JOIN `user` u ON u.id = t.peer ORDER BY m.createTime DESC
